caveat: Historical reference is Swiss-Prot plus 12 third-party tokenized files, per-shard heuristic search. Q2 protein test identity>=50% with >=80% query and subject coverage; HtPIP screened separately against the same Q2 training reference. PT flag exclusion is 95% HSP union query coverage>=80%, not ANI. Any protein hit is not necessarily label leakage; no-hit is not proof of no exposure.
